*F-BC* (Broadcast) is part of *Channels, Agreement, Ledgers* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

As usually formulated, this functionality is not realizable against adaptive adversaries; a weakened variant is needed in that setting.

*References:*

- Canetti. [*Universally composable security: A new paradigm for cryptographic protocols*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2000/067). In 42nd IEEE Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science (FOCS), pages 136–145, 2001.
- Hirt and Zikas. [*Adaptively secure broadcast*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2009/230). In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2010, 2010.
- Garay et al. [*Adaptively secure broadcast, revisited*](https://people.csail.mit.edu/ranjit/papers/asb.pdf). In 30th ACM Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing (PODC), 2011.
